svg.aria-label: About Kyle Vu: full-stack engineer · local-first · privacy-first. I build practical, well-crafted software — tools that make learning and everyday work easier. I care about local-first architecture, thoughtful UX, and getting the details right. now: growing Arbora, a study assistant that never phones home. next: exploring on-device RAG and local-first sync. into: spaced repetition (FSRS), desktop apps with Tauri. ask me: about Tauri, FSRS, or study tooling.
